text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Chiyono O! Um, I look forward 
to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I've always admired Maruzen-san, and I 
hoped that maybe one day we could race 
together..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"With a spirit of 'Every step Chiyo takes 
brings her closer to the gate,' I'll do my 
very best!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
